autoDenyPatterns.description: The workflow owns pushing. Commit to your branch and stop.
The workflow owns merging. Commit to your branch and stop.
Do not abandon the rebase. Resolve it, or stop and say you cannot.
The workflow opens and merges pull requests.
The workflow closes issues, via the merge commit.
The workflow owns issue labels and state.

policies.name: Agent harness
policies.description: The worker must not rewrite the workflow that dispatched it.
policies.blockMessage: {file} belongs to the workflow that dispatched you, not to this ticket.
